To enforce W as a normalized weighting coefficient, we apply value clipping: W ← clip (DB(p∥q), 0, 1) (5) This operation induces three interpretable regimes: • W = 1: Maximum emphasis on general quality when eE[y] and eE[f (x)] exhibit strong divergence (DB ≥ 1). • W = 0: Exclusive focus on brightness-aligned refine- ment when distributions coincide (DB = 0). • Smooth transition via W ∈ (0, 1) during intermediate phases .
